entry.title: New: Resolution 357 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO MALAMA O PUNA FOR EXPENSES RELATED TO THE MAINTENANCE AND BEAUTIFICATION OF THE RENE SIRACUSA PĀHOA ROUNDABOUT

Transfers $3,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 4)
